data.name: Sunward
data.detailed_description:
Dig in. Build up. Reach for the stars.

Sunward is a deep, cozy space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, trade on a living market, and grow a single station core into a sprawling, freighter-linked empire that spans the solar system and beyond! Build at your own pace and reach for the stars.

Mine, refine, and trade

Extractor drills bite into asteroids and cargo shuttles haul the ore home. Smelt metal plate, blow glass, draw wire, then climb the production tree to alloys, circuits, and high value Components in a flexible Fabricator. Sell to Earth on a dynamic market where every sale nudges the price down and scarcity drives it back up.

Build a modular station

Snap buildings together to build efficient networks. Every module needs air, workers and power. Reactors burn fuel, life support pressurizes habitats, and survey scanners chart the space around you. Zoom in close and watch your colonists work inside.

Grow a colony

Workers are your population. Colonists ride in from colonized worlds, fill habitats, and draw wages and consumer goods. Keep them paid and supplied and morale stays high, lifting both colony growth and factory output. Neglect them and you face a recoverable slump, never a sudden loss.

Expand across the solar system

Zoom all the way out to the system map: the planets ringing the Sun, each its own buildable world with its own asteroid field. Colonize, settle, and trade between regions and systems, with empire freighters running goods, and colonists along the orbits. Colonies you have left keep producing while you are away.

Research and megastructures

Spend research points on a tech tree that unlocks new drills, resources, and buildings. Recover artifacts to reveal hidden technologies, then raise the great works: a planet anchored Space Elevator, a Warp Gate that opens new star systems on a galaxy map, and finally the Ascension Spire, your victory, with free play continuing after.

Survive the void

Solar flares and micro-asteroid showers can strike, and your risk depends on where you settle. Inner orbits bake, outer orbits get pelted. Build detectors, ride out the storm, and follow the always on Solar System News Network as telegraphed scenarios swing the markets and give you time to plan.

Key features

  • A satisfying production loop: mine, refine, manufacture, and sell up a multi tier economy.

  • Modular base building with airlock networks, power, oxygen, and see-inside interiors.

  • A living colony: workforce, morale, wages, and immigration policy.

  • A whole solar system of colonizable worlds linked by freighters and contracts.

  • A tech tree and alien Xeno research gating buildings, recipes, and megastructures.

  • An endgame goal ladder: Space Elevator, Warp Gate, galaxy expansion, Ascension Spire.

  • Dynamic markets and telegraphed news scenarios that reward planning.

  • No hard failure, only recoverable setbacks. Play relaxed or optimize hard.

  • A pixel-art look rendered with procedural shaders.

  • Windows, Mac and Linux, Steam Deck ready, with Steam Cloud and achievements.

Dig in. Build up. Reach for the stars.

data.short_description: A deep, relaxed space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, and trade on a living market while you build a modular station, grow a colony, and expand across the solar system and beyond into a freighter-linked empire.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2-capable (Intel HD 5xx / GT 1030+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any Metal-capable GPU (Apple Silicon, or integrated Intel/AMD)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or a dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2-capable (Intel HD 5xx / GT 1030+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Recent 64-bit distribution
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
